title: Remove Duplicates In Order
description: Write a function `remove_duplicates(items)` that returns a new list containing only the unique elements of `items`, keeping their original order of appearance. Do not mutate the original list.

hidden_tests.kind: all duplicate items with mutation check

hints: Deduplication requires remembering what you have already observed without disrupting the input order.
Be careful not to call .remove() or .pop() directly on the argument list, as mutating input is prohibited.
Using list(set(items)) directly loses the original element order because Python sets are unordered.
Maintain a tracking set of seen items alongside a new result list, appending items only on their first appearance.
